name: Shodan CT hostnames service (ctl.shodan.io)
tier_rationale: Shodan LLC, an established company with published terms and a business offering (A8 trusted; same operator as the core provider shodan); P001 trusted and P304 cond 5 'trusted - ... Shodan'.

reliability.justification: Shodan's mirror of public Certificate Transparency logs (the same upstream as crt.sh); the completeness of the mirror is not documented.

hostnames.title: Shodan CT log hostnames API /api/v1/domain/{domain}/hostnames (keyless)

terms.quote: ctl.shodan.io = noncommercial, same licence decision as Shodan InternetDB

hostnames.notes: Quote: binding council text (P001 cond 2); research C0018 terms 'Shodan public CT service, no key; Shodan ToS apply' (verified_live 200). ctl.shodan.io/api/v1/domain/{domain}/hostnames (keyless; the landing page describes a local CT mirror searchable by domain or certificate SHA-256). Off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared (P001 cond 3). Upstream family ct-logs, as crt.sh. Used by ct_logs.
hostnames.licensed_alternative: A Shodan licence, or a licence_allow entry recording Shodan's written permission, covering ctl.shodan.io (P001 cond 3); crt.sh (crtsh.search) alone keeps ct_logs useful.

notes: Shared seed for batches p1-G01-1 (P001): batches only extend it (shodan_ctl__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Not a core host: the core provider shodan keeps api, cvedb, internetdb and www.shodan.io. Undocumented limit: min_interval 1 s (research C0018 'keep to 1 req/s'); no quota block.
